option_flat_map: pub fnc main():int{ val Option<int> source = Some(2); return source.flat_map<int>(|int n| -> { return Some(n * 2); }).unwrap(); }
result_map_err: pub fnc main():int{ val Result<int,string> source = Err("error"); return source.map_err<string>(|string msg| -> { return msg; }).unwrap_or(0); }
future_and_then: async fnc seed():int{return 2;} pub fnc main():int{ val Future<int> result = seed().and_then(|int n| -> { return seed(); }); return await result; }
observable_filter_map: pub fnc main():int{ val Observable<int> items = from_values([1,2]); val Observable<int> mapped = filter_map(items, |int n| -> { return Some(n); }); return 0; }
stream_filter_map: pub fnc main():int{ val Stream<int> items = make_stream(); return items.filter_map(|int n| -> { return Some(n); }).next().unwrap(); }
channel_is_not_observable: pub fnc main():int{ val Channel<int> ch = Channel.new<int>(0); val Observable<int> source = ch; return 0; }
